Enable paired NFC tags first. For normal toggle/disable tags, use Write NFC tag instead.

QR codes can run these Switchly actions when scanned:
• Enable or disable protection
• Toggle the current state
• Start a temporary action
• Switch profiles

For a stricter setup, keep only the control channels you want to use enabled.

Saved barcodes link a physical code to a Switchly action:
• Enable, disable, or toggle protection
• Start a temporary action
• Switch profiles

For more friction, keep the barcode away from your phone. “Ask when scanned” lets you choose the duration during the scan.

Paired tags are recognized by their unique ID.
• Read-only tags use the action configured in Switchly.
• Writable tags can use their stored action or a custom override.
• Daily-use and cooldown limits apply to unlock and protection-pause actions.

Pairing is optional for normal writable Switchly tags unless you need per-tag settings or limits.
